headline: Pulse Local brings AI budgeting to your Mac, running models entirely on-device for privacy
summary: Pulse Local is a complete budgeting app for Mac that processes all your financial data and AI queries locally, ensuring your ledger and questions never leave your machine.
details: Pulse Local is a new budgeting app for Mac that distinguishes itself by running its AI models entirely on your local machine. This ensures that your financial ledger and any questions you ask about your finances never leave your device, prioritizing user privacy.

Unlike other budgeting apps that store ledgers on their servers or send queries to hosted AI models, Pulse Local keeps both your data and the AI models directly on your disk. There are no external endpoints for your questions or financial rows to be sent to, reinforcing its privacy commitment.

The app allows users to track spending, compare months, and check budget availability, with AI-powered answers derived from transactions. It explains figures and budgeting terms, and if the AI is unsure, it will state so rather than guessing, with all AI answers clearly labeled.

Pulse Local supports any of the world's currencies, importing bank files from various regions and writing figures in the local format. While bank sync via Plaid currently covers US banks, users everywhere else can import CSV files in 'Local mode'.

The app offers all features at every price point, with a one-time payment model instead of a subscription for the core app. An optional 'Sync Pass' is available for $29 a year for bank synchronization. A Windows version is planned for future release.
